payload.text: After the WP13 cutover, candidates under hv's simpler-or-easier rule, none in WP11 commit 3 (fe4b677; critic-rust's second read, via cc): (a) unify the three picture rules, the engine's, pplr_pictures' and the index's, which differ as their legacy scripts did; that changes behaviour on real data, so it is a divergence and needs hv's ruling (a comment on tree::PICTURES records the difference); (b) Pair.how's vocabulary as an enum, behaviour-preserving; (c) matches() leaves has_inetloc false to mean 'not read', a plain bool documented on the field; (d) workbook write() fills Merged's rows by position while the reader and the styling go by header. (e) One macOS gate: contacts/mod.rs, handler.rs and icons.rs each test cfg!(target_os) with their own message, beside open.rs's macos_only(why); one helper for every gate, behaviour-preserving if the messages stay. Left as is by vc's ruling: an option taken as another's value (sync --link --group --apply) falls to a dry run, which is safe.
